name: prowler-manage
description: Manage multiple Prowler App instances, one per Microsoft 365 tenant, published through Cloudflare Tunnel

scripts.build: node -e "for (const d of ['src','public']) for (const f of require('fs').readdirSync(d)) if (f.endsWith('.js')) require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',d+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'}); console.log('Syntax OK - no build step needed, run: pnpm start')"
